text: By daylight the pattern is quiet and dull. <break time="0.8s" /> But at night. <break time="0.8s" /> In any kind of light. <break time="0.8s" /> It becomes bars. <break time="0.8s" /> And the woman behind it. <break time="0.8s" /> Is as plain as can be. <break time="0.8s" /> I can see her shaking the bars hard. <break time="0.8s" /> As if she wanted to climb through but nobody could climb through such a pattern. <break time="0.8s" /> For it holds so tightly. <break time="0.8s" /> There are things in that paper. <break time="0.8s" /> That nobody knows but me. <break time="0.8s" /> Or ever will and I do not intend to tell John. <break time="0.8s" /> Since it does not do to trust people too much. <break time="0.8s" /> Both John and Jennie. <break time="0.8s" /> Are secretly affected by the paper. <break time="0.8s" /> I believe. <break time="0.8s" /> For I once caught Jennie. <break time="0.8s" /> With her hand on it. <break time="0.8s" /> And she said. <break time="0.8s" /> It stained everything it touched. <break time="0.8s" /> There is something else. <break time="0.8s" /> About that paper. <break time="0.8s" /> The smell. <break time="0.8s" /> Which creeps all over the house. <break time="0.8s" /> Waiting for me on the stairs. <break time="0.8s" /> And getting into my hair. <break time="0.8s" /> The only thing. <break time="0.8s" /> That I can think of that it is like is the color of the paper itself. <break time="0.8s" /> A yellow smell. <break time="0.8s" /> The most enduring odor I have ever met. <break time="0.8s" /> There is also a very funny mark. <break time="0.8s" /> Low down on the wall. <break time="0.8s" /> Near the mopboard. <break time="0.8s" /> A long, straight, even smooch. <break time="0.8s" /> As if it had been rubbed over and over. <break time="0.8s" /> I think the woman gets out. <break time="0.8s" /> In the daytime because I have seen her. <break time="0.8s" /> From every window. <break time="0.8s" /> Creeping along the road. <break time="0.8s" /> And hiding under the blackberry vines. <break time="0.8s" /> I do not blame her a bit. <break time="0.8s" /> Since it must be very humiliating. <break time="0.8s" /> To be caught creeping by daylight. <break time="0.8s" /> And I always lock the door. <break time="0.8s" /> When I do it myself.
